author: The Infographics Show
description:
The Titan submersible didn't implode because of one unexpected failure. It was the result of years of ignored warnings, risky engineering decisions, and a CEO determined to prove the experts wrong. New evidence from the official investigation reveals the crew's final moments, while the recovered wreckage exposes flaws that may have doomed the sub long before its last dive.
What looked like a tragic accident now appears to have been entirely preventable.

This video uncovers the real story behind the OceanGate disaster, why Titan's carbon-fiber hull was such a controversial design, and how Stockton Rush bypassed industry standards, dismissed safety concerns, and silenced whistleblowers.
We examine the warnings from David Lochridge and Karl Stanley, the misleading claims involving NASA and Boeing, the dangers of carbon-fiber delamination, OceanGate's legal loopholes, and the 2025 investigation that reconstructed Titan's final moments.
